title: How to organise the surface, rail, and safety zone | Patio or Deck
description:
The structure you stand on and lean against, kept sound and kept clear.

This is the Surface, Rail, and Safety Zone in the Patio or Deck. About 45-75 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Nothing on the deck that is not furniture, daylight visible through the gaps between boards, no green film on the shaded treads, and every rail post immovable when you push it hard.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: This zone earns its state by having nothing stored in it.
Straighten: Walk the route from the door to the steps to the gate carrying a full laundry basket in both arms so you canno
Shine: Rake the gaps between boards clear with a putty knife or a paint stirrer, because a blocked gap holds water ag
Safety: Grab the top rail at every post and push hard, outward and then down.
Standardize: A dated tag inside the back door records when the rail was last pushed and the boards last probed, so the next
Sustain: Every time you sweep the deck, push the rail at two posts before the broom goes away.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Nothing stored on the walking route, gaps clear, and a dated tag recording the last rail push and board probe.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/patio-or-deck-the-surface-rail-and-safety-zone.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
